prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 53.0 °C (71% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 59.3 °C (52% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.8 °C (61% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.32 l/min (4% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 378 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.4 % (4% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.8 bar (within 2% of healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
